title: Detailed cookie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cookie body: warm golden base -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='#D9A44E'/>
  <!-- Lighter top-left shading for depth -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='#E8BC66' opacity='0.5' clip-path='circle(40px at 50px 50px)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#EEC97B' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- Baked rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='none' stroke='#B9823A' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- Chocolate chips: deep but lit purple-brown -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='7' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='30' r='6' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='30' r='3' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='7.5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='6.5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='3' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='44' r='6' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='44' r='3' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='5.5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='68' r='6' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='68' r='3' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#5B2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#7B4A7C'/>
  <!-- Crumb texture: small lighter specks -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#C89440'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#C89440'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#C89440'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#C89440'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='1.5' fill='#C89440'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#C89440'/>
  <!-- Bite mark: curved notch on right side -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='16' fill='#2A1A3A'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='13' fill='#1A1028'/>
</svg>
